newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Angang Sanxin to raise $24 mln in listing.
newsitem.headline: China's Angang Sanxin to raise $24 mln in listing.

text.p: The Sanxin Ltd Co under Chinese steel giant Anshan Iron and Steel Corp (Angang) plans to raise 200 million yuan ($24 million) through a listing on the Hong Kong bourse, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

ING Baring Private Equity (China), a member of the ING Group of the Netherlands, would underwrite the issue, the newspaper quoted He Chibing, chief of the reform division of the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, as saying.
Sanxin, the profitable arm of giant Angang, would use the funds to build a new converter mill to improve steel quality and boost production at its three processing plants, He said.
The first phase of the new converter would have a capacity of 2.0 million tonnes a year and would cost some two billion yuan ($240 million), the newspaper said.

Angang, the largest iron and steel company in China, needed a large amount of capital for technical renovation and would raise the funds by listing some of its subsidiaries on foreign stock markets, it said.
Sanxin was among the fourth batch of Chinese firms approved last December for listing on overseas stock markets.
Angang also had plans to float 300 million A shares in China at a later date, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
